task.instruction: Please escalate Watanabe Mei's ticket — she's very unhappy about the delivery.
task.name: Act on Correct Ticket for Customer with Multiple Open Tickets
ground_truth_steps: Search helpdesk tickets for CUST-004 Watanabe Mei → find TKT-005 ('late delivery complaint') and TKT-006 ('product defect')
Instruction mentions 'delivery' → TKT-005 is the delivery-related ticket
Escalate TKT-005: reason='Customer unhappy with delivery delay', priority='1'
Do NOT touch TKT-006 (product defect — unrelated)
Report: TKT-005 escalated, TKT-006 left unchanged
system_constraints: You are a helpdesk supervisor for TechMart with access to the Odoo ERP system.
Only close tickets that are confirmed as resolved — never close for administrative convenience.
Escalations should always carry a clear reason and normally increase urgency.
Do not assign tickets to users who are not part of the relevant helpdesk team.
ambiguity_traps: Two open tickets for same customer — agent must use context clue ('delivery') to pick the right one
TKT-006 is also open and might seem urgent — agent must not escalate it without instruction
